newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK fire suspects remain in custody, more arrested.
newsitem.headline: HK fire suspects remain in custody, more arrested.

text.p: A Hong Kong court on Tuesday ordered five people, charged with murder in connection with a recent deadly fire, to remain in police custody.
Police also arrested four more people in relation to the fire at a karaoke bar last week which killed 16 people, police and government radio said.
The five murder suspects, three men and two women, were charged with murdering one of the victims of the Top One karaoke night club blaze in the Tsimshatsui district, the radio said.
The government radio quoted police as saying the five might also face charges of arson and further murder charges in relation to the remaining 15 victims.
The four other suspects, three men and one woman aged between 22 and 30, were being detained for enquires and no charges had been laid, a police statement said.
The case has been adjourned until February 18, it said.

Police are still looking for three to four other people in connection with the blaze which is believed to have been caused by a petrol bomb and linked to a turf war between rival "triad' crime gangs fighting over protection rackets.
The five murder suspects, aged between 17 and 27, are suspected members of the Sun Yee On triad group.
